discover-seed-v1-roscash.title: ROSCASH
discover-seed-v1-roscash.summary: On-chain rotating savings circles and pocket money for your community.
discover-seed-v1-roscash.idea: Community pocket money on chain: tips, small payments, and local rewards without a bank in the middle.
discover-seed-v1-roscash.audience: Neighborhood groups, creators, and anyone who moves small amounts between friends.
discover-seed-v1-roscash.whyToken: A dedicated asset keeps community balances separate from everyday network fees and makes sharing rules visible to everyone.

discover-seed-v1-tpitp.title: People Tips
discover-seed-v1-tpitp.summary: Send small thank-you tips to creators and teams on the People network.
discover-seed-v1-tpitp.idea: Say thanks with a token built for micro-support — concerts, streams, and open-source maintainers.
discover-seed-v1-tpitp.audience: Fans, patrons, and teams that collect many small thank-yous.
discover-seed-v1-tpitp.whyToken: Tips stay in the community’s own ledger instead of a closed app balance.

discover-seed-v1-tmark.title: TMARK
discover-seed-v1-tmark.summary: On-chain badge for milestones you reach together as a group.
discover-seed-v1-tmark.idea: Mark milestones together — events, launches, and shared goals with an on-chain badge token.
discover-seed-v1-tmark.audience: Clubs, cohorts, and product teams that celebrate progress in public.
discover-seed-v1-tmark.whyToken: Holders can prove they took part from day one without exposing private data.

discover-seed-v1-swap.title: People Swap
discover-seed-v1-swap.summary: Swap test community tokens for PPL right in the browser.
discover-seed-v1-swap.idea: Exchange demo community tokens against PPL in the browser — no separate exchange account.
discover-seed-v1-swap.audience: People trying testnet assets before they commit to a project.
discover-seed-v1-swap.whyToken: Liquidity pairs show real price discovery for new launches on the network.

discover-seed-v1-factory.title: Token Factory
discover-seed-v1-factory.summary: Launch a fair community token with name, image, and built-in rules.
discover-seed-v1-factory.idea: Launch a project token with a picture, name, and fair launch rules — straight from the site.
discover-seed-v1-factory.audience: Founders who want a community asset without writing smart contracts by hand.
discover-seed-v1-factory.whyToken: The factory enforces vesting and community pool splits so supporters see the same rules as you.

discover-seed-v1-nft.title: Creator collectibles
discover-seed-v1-nft.summary: Mint a visual collectible for your drop, event, or membership.
discover-seed-v1-nft.idea: Mint a visual collectible that represents your drop, event, or membership card.
discover-seed-v1-nft.audience: Artists and communities who want something scarce but easy to share.
discover-seed-v1-nft.whyToken: NFTs carry metadata and provenance on the same chain as your project token.
